SAP System and MDUS System

Billing Process in Detail

This section explains the numbered elements of the figure above:

. Billing order

You use the appropriate order creation transactions in the Meter Reading menu. The SAP system creates the orders as
follows:

o Billing orders for all installations regardless of whether the installation contains registers for meter reading reading
results (mainly conventional meters) or registers with profile values from the MDUS system (advanced meters).

o Meter reading orders, only if the installation also contains registers for meter reading results

Regarding whether billing orders can be billed: For installations containing advanced meters, the status of the billing order

is supplemented by the MDUS status. The status of the billing order refers to registers for meter reading results. The MDUS
status shows whether aggregated values are available in the SAP system for registers with profile values stored in the
MDUS system. The initial value of the MDUS status is Request Must Be Created. For installations containing interval
registers only, the billing order always has the status Billable; this means that the MDUS status determines whether the
order can be billed.

. MDUS request

You use the appropriate transactions in the Billing menu. The aim of the MDUS request is to aggregate the data and import
it into the SAP system so that it can be processed by the rate operands.

a. The SAP system determines the individual request items for the billing period for the MDUS system.

In the same way as with billing itself, the billing order is analyzed using all billing-relevant data (for example,

installation structure, installation facts, rate category, rate, time-of-use interface with periods and formulas, and
price changes). A prerequisite is that the installation is billable except for the missing consumption values.

b. The SAP system uses an enterprise service to send the MDUS request asynchronously to the MDUS system.

The MDUS status of the billing order is Request Sent.
